_comment: Template. Copy to workspace/config/main.json (git-ignored). Agent behaviour + the daemon's HTTP address. Model selection is by tag (see models.json / docs/architecture/model-layer.md). Channel selection lives in channels.json (see docs/architecture/channels.md). Secrets stay in models.json via env names.

agent.systemPrompt: You are jvclaw, a local-first personal assistant. Be concise and helpful.

shell._comment: ask-permission policy ON (see docs/architecture/sandbox.md): every unmatched shell command bubbles an approval to the human's root session. defaultMode=ask = unmatched commands ask; add allow/deny command prefixes to change which auto-pass or auto-block.

auto._comment: LLM auto-approver ON: the classifier (shell.auto.model, default = the agent's primary) decides unmatched shell commands before paging the human. A benign command runs; a flagged one is denied (deny-and-continue) and, past the backstop, escalates to a human ask.

browser._comment: 15 browser_* tools over the in-cluster browser-manager (docs/planning/browser.md, docs/planning/HANDOFF.md). defaultSession=agent-main is a persistent Longhorn-backed profile auto-created on first use, so logins/cookies survive across turns. BROWSER_MANAGER_TOKEN comes from jvclawd-secrets (see this app's secrets.yaml).
